<template>
<v-container>
  <v-card class="mx-auto my-0" color="grey-lighten-3">
    <v-app-bar
    color="white"
    >
      <template v-slot:prepend>
        <v-img src="@/assets/logo.png" :width="200" class="custom-v-img"></v-img>
      </template>
  
      <v-spacer></v-spacer>
  
      <v-btn icon @click="value = !value">
        <v-icon>mdi-account</v-icon>
      </v-btn>
      <v-btn v-show="value" @click="logout">
        Sair
      </v-btn>
    </v-app-bar>
  </v-card>
  
   <v-row justify="center" >
    <v-col cols="">
      <v-card-title class="text--primary titulo-login">Dados pessoais</v-card-title>
    </v-col>
   </v-row>
</v-container>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('AUTH_TOKEN');
      this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/login');
    }
  }
}

</script>
